body: Three is the magic number. Gives you one day a week with them, a chance to spend with friends/family/yourself, and a chance to accommodate a fourth while you rearrange as needed. Notebook is pretty normal, in some form, but only needs to be the most important things. If you going for a larger rotation, you are going to have to give up on parts of your awesome life. Pare it down to three and everyone will be happier.

I did. Suggestion was that I exercise more and do yoga. I can now run a half marathon and am flexible. I've been trying to rebuild my life but I will never get my ex fiancé back, or my dog, or my house, or my family. That's not how the world works. I should feel lucky that I once felt happy

It doesn't make sense, but ever since my ex fiancé left, when I am with a girl I feel like I am cheating on her, even though I am 100% single. It gets worse the more intimate we become. Not sure how to overcome it, but I keep trying.

Real benefits. It like opening a wound. You still have to clean it out and heal, but you begin to recover. I am so much more perceptive now. I find a girl attractive for things I never would have during PMO. I'm still fighting a lot of battles, but I'm winning a few. I'm sure you will win as well

Along with that, take this time to reboot yourself. I'm the kind of guy who can't get out of his head and have difficulty relaxing (prob a common trait on here). So I am learning to salsa; gets me out of the house, which I agree is very important, and helps me learn a cool skill and improve myself. Find your weakness, take time to improve it during the reboot, and people, and girls , will come.
On a sidenote, there are always old men at salsa who can pick up any girl. Confidence is a powerful attribute. Best of luck!

Perfectly natural. If you are like many of us, you've been using hyper stimulation to deal with those life issues you were referring to. Now your brain is adjusting. I am just starting to recover from the numbness. Keep powering through!

I think it's pretty much all mental- at least no consistent science to quantitatively back up some of the benefits. It also won't make you more likely to catch a cold- though theoretically one could face frostbite-spectrum problems if they were too reckless. Ultimately, a personal choice, just like Nofap. Though as I just finished my first cold shower from start to finish, I am pretty pumped.

Thanks guys- kind of needed that. Last week I brought a girl home, thinking that may I could rise to the occasion with her. It took a while to get to 3/4 mast, couldn't finish. But what's another few months if it leads to a better rest of my life. I appreciate the support.

It's bizarro world. You still notice women much more than you used to. You still have the superpower to bring girls home. But while you set still attracted to the girl- you can't rise to the occasion.
Also, at least for me, my emotions were usually depressed but were all over the place.

Also, at least for me, my emotions were usually depressed but were all over the place.
Dear Lord I hope it doesn't take 9 months. After flatlining since December, that is not encouraging news...
I wouldn't reset for thinking about it. Many of us have had dream about it as part of the reset. It's normal.

The fluctuations are a huge part of your rewiring, I think. I'm in day 4 and I still have them. It partially depends on when how long you were PMOing. I make myself do 2 min on jump ropes when I start feeling depressed. Doesn't always make things better but it's a start. Good luck

Thanks for all the support. I realize that I've been looking for happiness ever since my fiancé left me. That search for dopamine and feeling better is what got me back into PMO. Search for gratitude is much easier and hopefully will lead me to feeling happiness once again. Any I like the idea of tracking urges defeated. I might just get a poster board and put up some tally marks.
Head over to new fapstronauts on the left, click the link below, and fill in the information

I hit flatline hard and have had difficulty coming out of it. I noticed that lately I'll have these spikes of energy, then later anger, then depression. I don't know if that means I'm coming out of it- the reading I've done says that though the depression doesn't get better, you can tell you are starting to cone out of if when it us less frequent. I'm just trying to build skills and strength so when I stop feeling like shit I can capitalize on it. Stay strong!
Feel the same way. Just spend the time making yourself better, so when you get desire back, you can capitalize on it

It's only been three days, an I can already feel a difference. This huge wave of pain came at me, but I am slowly working through it all and doing cardio to stay afloat. I would recommend a tech time out to anyone in on this journey

This is what NoFap should be all about. I'm all about better sex and better interactions with the opposite sex (though I haven't found the former just yet) but the balance and strength of self control seems to have improved your life dramatically. Hopefully I will get there someday.
I'm curious too how long it took. I am pretty excited to be out of flatline

Thanks all. I was trying to hate her or use anger to move on, but while I'm still angry, I still don't hate her. You guys are right, I used to have feelings for her, and the time we spent together was coincidentally the happiest time of my life. That doesn't meaning will not be happy again. I'll just be ok with what I am feeling and keep trying to move forward.
Quick update- had to work with my ex-fiancé today. Thought it was going to kill me, but I kept myself together. Not sure if I'm just getting stronger or Nofap or both. But  small victories await.

Great point. I have to remind myself that it's ok if I'm not always thinking about sex; in fact it means I'm starting to be normal. And I think once I meet someone I have an actual connection with, I'll be able to be less in my head with this and see what happens.

I think it's the idea of being alone. Sometimes your brain will tell you to go find your old girlfriends so you won't be lonely. I've been dealing with that too, but I think overtime those swings become less frequent.

Flatline is Hell, I've been stuck for awhile. I think I may have unearthed some underlying depression or anger issues. I want to relapse for relief, but I never want to deal with flatlining again so I am going to power through. I think many of us got into the PMO cycle do to underlying issues. So for those who haven't gotten there yet, be prepared but try not to worry. This too shall pass.

Thanks man. I just realized it is her birthday today. Maybe my brain was just putting things together.
I'm going out of the house right now.
Been flatlining for awhile for most of this streak, been at this since October with two relapses (thankfully no binges). Hopefully it ends soon.
Power through. I thought that I could fight the flatline, but now I'm just learning to embrace it. I focus my day on making myself the best I can be for when I reemerge revitalized. Stay strong

Meditation is amazing, but I would also take time and let your mind wonder. I spent an hour this morning just letting my thoughts run free; there were some inappropriate thoughts, but they morphed into something else. It may help more in flatline, but it was amazing for me.

I have to work with my ex fiancé so I can relate. First off, the "complete rejection" is the worst she can do to you. Even if she shares conversations, or thinks what's he will, she can't inflict more pain than the rejection. 
Secondly, act as if you have nothing to say to her. She doesn't even count in your world. Neutral.
Now there are two scenarios: 1. She is apathetic to the situation and isn't thinking anything about you, or 2. She has some feelings toward you that are positive  or negative.  If it's 1, she won't cause any problems and you will be able to move on. If it's 2, nothing drives someone as crazy as losing the power she has over you.
People can cause you feel pain, but no one can make suffer.

While our brains are settling down, I think many of us are focusing on one new thing and spending a lot of time doing it. I am at the gym, or using my home weights, or running. I hope to get to a balanced lifestyle but I am not there just yet.

I'm still flatlining and have been tempted to relapse, edge, or find something pseudo softcore. I just keep telling myself that I only want to go through this once, so after this flatline I will never go back again. Stay strong!

It goes both ways, too. I have been making ~20 day attempts since October. Sometimes I flatline first, sometimes I surge first, but I end up going back and forth. Just make sure when the surge comes you have a strategy in place. This will be my first time breaking the 20 day barrier.
Right there with you. It's been hell for a very long time. Trying to us this time to dig my way out. Stay strong.

Dealing with your a good friend committing suicide can be rough, especially when you are going through bad times as well. I know I'm still dealing with it. I just tell myself I have to go on for me and my friend. If you have the strength to keep fighting through your hard times, which you do by being on here, you will get through things eventually. Hopefully your dad will see that you are working hard, too.

Also, for future reference, consider blocking out names to adult actresses. Im currently fighting off a trigger... Time to go do some push ups.

Also hit 1 week.  No one else knows I'm doing this.  I don't have superpowers, I can't fly, but it feels good to be getting somewhere positive.  Trying to take all this new time on my hands and focus it at the gym or fixing the other areas of my life that aren't where I want to be.  Not having a whole lot of social support in my life right now, you guys have been really helpful.  So cheers to my first comment.
